2609.40361.title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
2609.40361.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives. Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. We therefore evaluate and optimize for AUROC, a threshold-free score that ranks positives above negatives and is invariant to class balance. We focus on prompt optimization in MLLMs. Reflective methods such as GEPA use a binary scores matrix with one row per evaluation instance and one column per candidate prompt; cells record per-instance correctness, so the column average is accuracy and drives candidate selection. We introduce pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE), which replaces each correctness row with a pairwise-ordering row over (positive, negative) instance pairs: the cell is 1 if the candidate scores the positive higher than the paired negative. The column average then equals empirical AUROC (by the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney identity). We apply this swap at all three layers the prompt evolution search reads from - the scores matrix that decides Pareto dominance, the per-example feedback to the reflection LM, and final candidate selection - at no extra model calls and with no surrogate loss. Across three diseases on MIMIC, accuracy-based prompt evolution can degrade ranking; Ranking-PE reverses this, beating the accuracy-based recipe by +5.8 AUROC pp on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 pp on MedGemma-4B. Ablations examine each design component and show that a medical-grade visual backbone - via vision-encoder-tuned SFT or medical pretraining - is a prerequisite that prompt search cannot replace - our recipe extends reflective prompt evolution from text-only data to multimodal clinical decision-making.
2609.40361.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）正在快速推進臨床診斷，但它們的適應管道仍然以準確性為目標。臨床數據的類別不平衡嚴重：一個持續的多數預測器可以達到90%以上的準確率，但在臨床上卻毫無用處。因此，我們評估並優化AUROC，這是一個無閾值的分數，將正例排在負例之上，且對類別平衡不變。我們專注於MLLMs中的提示優化。反思方法如GEPA使用一個二元分數矩陣，每個評估實例一行，每個候選提示一列；單元格記錄每個實例的正確性，因此列平均值是準確率並驅動候選選擇。我們引入了對偶級別的Pareto提示演化（Ranking-PE），它用一個成對排序行替換每個正確性行，該行針對（正例，負例）實例對進行排序：如果候選者對正例的評分高於配對的負例，則單元格為1。然後，列平均值等於經驗AUROC（根據Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney恆等式）。我們在提示演化搜索所讀取的所有三個層級應用此交換——決定Pareto優勢的分數矩陣、對反思LM的每個示例反饋以及最終候選選擇——無需額外的模型調用且無替代損失。在MIMIC上的三種疾病中，基於準確性的提示演化可能會降低排名；Ranking-PE則逆轉了這一點，在微調的Qwen3-VL-8B上超越基於準確性的配方5.8 AUROC pp，在MedGemma-4B上超越16.2 pp。消融實驗檢查每個設計組件，並顯示醫療級視覺骨幹——通過視覺編碼器調整的SFT或醫療預訓練——是提示搜索無法替代的前提條件——我們的配方將反思提示演化從純文本數據擴展到多模態臨床決策。
